context: A small therapy office. Mei has come back to Dr. Saito (here playing a therapist she sees once a quarter). They've known each other for years.
purpose: therapy session — long-term patient, careful gentle prompting

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: こんにちは、メイさん。お変わり、ありますか。
lines.en: Hello, Mei. How have you been managing?
lines.style: Warm professional greeting. Steady eye contact. Unhurried cadence. Leans in slightly—inviting rather than clinical.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: はい…少し。…今、本当に、よく眠れて。
lines.en: Yes… a little better. …I'm actually sleeping well now.
lines.style: Quiet relief in the voice. Slight brightness emerging. Pause before 'sleeping'—acknowledging the surprise of improvement. Small, genuine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 本当に？それは、嬉しい変化ですね。
lines.style: Genuine pleasure, no performance. Warm nod in the voice. Sits with the moment—lets the good news breathe.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Yes. …Work feels a little lighter too.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Voice carries quiet confidence. Measured pace—not rushing the positive momentum.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: いいですね。…何が、変わったと思いますか。
lines.en: That's good. …What do you think made the difference?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry. Curious but never pressuring. Soft opening, letting her guide the answer. Doctor's patience in the silence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: …(beat) ちゃんと、自分のために、時間取れてる。
lines.en: …(beat) I'm actually making time for myself now. Real time.
lines.style: Small pause before speaking—gathering honesty. Voice steadies on the realization. Unforced clarity. Slight warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: それ、本当に、大事ですよね。
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Firm but gentle emphasis on 'genuinely.' Not rushed—lets the truth settle. Warm presence unchanged.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 心配は、まだある。でも、前より、少し。
lines.en: I still worry sometimes. But…less than I did.
lines.style: Honest measurement. No downplaying. Slight pause before 'less'—holding the before and after in mind. Tired but steady.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: うん。…大丈夫ですよ、その「少し」が、本当に大切。
lines.en: That matters. That 'less' really does matter.
lines.style: Direct reassurance with warmth underneath. Light emphasis on 'matters.' Sits forward slightly. Voice carries both steadiness and genuine care.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: …ありがとうございます。先生に、言えて、楽になる。
lines.en: …Thank you. Just being able to say it out loud—it helps.
lines.style: Soft gratitude. Breath of relief after the 'thank you.' Voice quiets on the confession. Tender, genuine exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: こちらこそ。…次は、いつにしましょうか。
lines.en: Of course. …Shall we schedule the next visit?
lines.style: Gentle shift to logistics. Warm, professional closing. Unhurried—respecting the moment while moving forward.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 三ヶ月後で、本当に、大丈夫だと思います。
lines.en: Three months sounds right. I think that will be good.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Clear, steady voice. Small nod in the delivery—ownership of the timeline. Genuine and grounded.
